purpose: Build the final Love Hurts commerce scene around a separately approved, protected FASHN customer/product foreground without allowing the environment provider to redraw it.

composition.brand_object: The exact protected enchanted rose remains sharply legible opposite the product.

physically weighted Love Hurts monument scale

native_scene_workflow.foreground: Founder-approved front-facing LH-003 VTO candidate, protected as RGB plus BiRefNet alpha; rear pockets remain source-authority-only and not rendered-visible.

segmentation.rgb_rule: Alpha-only segmentation; accepted foreground interior RGB must remain byte-identical.

background.prompt: Wide cinematic Fractured Chamber architecture with a deep ruined gothic cathedral volume, radial tracery window high in the rear wall, towering black stone arches, aged iron, restrained deep-red drape accents, cool moonlit volumetric shafts, low warm practical spill reserved for the right-side protected-object zone, and a cracked wet obsidian floor with physically plausible reflections. Preserve an open left-center customer zone, an open right monument zone, an unobstructed central depth corridor, and grounded floor contact space. Environment only. No people, no garments, no products, no text, no wordmarks, no signage, no hearts, no roses, no sculptures, no monuments, no robed figures, no Beast characters, no ballrooms, no flower walls.

operations: occlusion and atmospheric depth behind protected subjects
composite.protected_rgb_rule: No global foreground regeneration. Any edge or light-mask operation requires before/after hashes and pixel-diff statistics, with zero changes in identity and LH-003 artwork, zipper, pocket, and waistband regions.

hard_fail_invariants: exactly four zippered pockets: two side and two back; zipperless pockets are forbidden
pocket count, pocket location, zipper closure, directional artwork, or garment construction drift
unapproved wearer identity or customer/product hierarchy below the first two focal levels
copied Love Hurts word monument, copied star/heart monument, or any monument beyond the protected rose dome and plinth
robed fantasy figure or empty monument tableau
floating contact, pasted edges, incoherent light, or unbound rose geometry

provider_capability.rule: FASHN may create only the reviewed front-facing wearer candidate; Runway may create only the empty environment; Comfy preserves and integrates approved pixels. No provider success implies product approval, native-integration approval, promotion, wiring, or deployment.

upstream_vto.role: Create one exact on-model LH-003 candidate before environment generation; this route never owns product truth or scene promotion.
